query: How do I install a curtain tie-back hook?

goal.title: Install a curtain holdback hook
goal.description: Hold a curtain hook against the wall, measure and mark its mounting holes, then select and swap drill bits to drill the holes, repeatedly widening them to fit wall anchors. Press the anchors into place, position the hook over them, and drive in screws with a screwdriver, checking and tightening the hook until it is secure. Finally gather the curtain and hook it in place.
goal.final_state: The hook is fastened flush to the wall with its screws tightened, and the curtain is gathered and held inside it beside the window.
procedure: Gather the curtain and mark an initial hook position.
Measure the spacing, reposition the hook, and mark its mounting holes again.
Select drill bits and drill the marked wall holes.
Repeatedly widen the holes and press wall anchors into them.
Align the hook with the anchors and start the mounting screws.
Tighten the screws and check the hook by hand.
Gather the curtain inside the mounted hook.

phases.description: Gather curtain and mark an initial hook position.
Measure and mark the hook position again.
Choose drill bits and drill mounting holes.
Fit anchors and repeatedly widen the holes.
Gather curtain inside hook and inspect.

coarse.instruction: Mark an initial curtain hook position
coarse.description: Put down the tape measure, gather the curtain to one side, hold the curtain hook against the wall, and use a marker to mark its mounting holes.
coarse.goal_contribution: Establishes an initial mounting position beside the curtain.

coarse.instruction: Measure and mark the hook position
coarse.description: Use the tape measure to check spacing from the window, reposition the curtain hook against the wall, and mark its mounting holes again with the marker.
coarse.goal_contribution: Refines the hook location and marks the holes to drill.
coarse.predictability_reason: The initial hook mark naturally leads to measuring and refining its position.

coarse.instruction: Drill mounting holes in the wall
coarse.description: Open the drill bit bag, fit a bit into the drill, and drill into the wall at the marked points, swapping to different bits and redrilling as needed to size the holes.
coarse.goal_contribution: Creates holes for the hook mounting hardware.
coarse.predictability_reason: Marked mounting points are ready for drilled holes.

coarse.instruction: Fit wall anchors into the holes
coarse.description: Open the wall anchor bag, take out an anchor, and repeatedly redrill each hole wider with different bits before pressing the anchors into the wall by hand.
coarse.goal_contribution: Seats anchors that will receive the mounting screws.
coarse.predictability_reason: Drilled holes need anchors to hold the hook.

coarse.instruction: Position the hook and start its screws
coarse.description: Hold the curtain hook up against the wall anchors, adjust its alignment, then pick up screws and start driving them into the anchors with a screwdriver.
coarse.goal_contribution: Connects the hook to the wall anchors.
coarse.predictability_reason: With anchors fitted, the hook can be positioned and screwed on.

coarse.description: Turn each screw fully into the wall anchors with the screwdriver, then grip and shake the hook by hand to check that it is firmly secured.
coarse.goal_contribution: Secures the hook and checks its attachment.

coarse.instruction: Gather the curtain inside the mounted hook
coarse.description: Pull the curtain aside, gather its folds by hand, and place it inside the mounted hook before stepping back to inspect the finished installation.
coarse.goal_contribution: Uses the installed hook to hold the curtain aside.
coarse.predictability_reason: The mounted holdback is ready to gather the curtain.
